responsibility: Implements analysis routines over the loop tree and loop bodies rather than structural loop rewrites. It detects and marks irreducible loops, counts total and average loop insns, computes expected iteration counts and loop nesting levels, initializes target register and spill cost models for loop optimizations, estimates register-pressure costs, marks loop-exit edges, finds likely exits, and extracts a loop’s hot execution path, supplying profitability and structural facts to later loop transforms.
